name: Build Classes
tagline: SUPERSEDED BY PILLAR ONE. Eight Builds, ONE government each — the Core-and-Fill split is retired.
body: Core Build sets what she fundamentally is: posture, scale, base silhouette, temperament-frame, first-read impression, and how the body organises itself. Fill Build decides how the thesis becomes flesh: softness, density, movement, erotic gravity, and titty, thigh and ass behaviour. RETIRED BY NEREID v8 PILLAR ONE. There is no Core-and-Fill layering any more: EVERY WOMAN HAS ONE PRIMARY BUILD EXPRESSION, and what used to be Fill is now handled by the specialist Pillars plus adopted Native Bodily Traits in Clinic notation. Valkyrie still requires OATHBOUND TEMPERAMENT. DANCER REQUIRES MOTION-LED TEMPERAMENT, NOT Tempo-Bound Presence, which was the Archive’s wording and is struck. See nereid-pillar-one and build-boundary.
rules: Ethereal — airy motion, quiet gravity, drift
